title: Characterizing Local and Correlated Pauli Noise in Quantum Teleportation Circuits
summary: We analytically characterize how the location and the local or correlated structure of stochastic Pauli errors affect a three-qubit coherent quantum-teleportation circuit. Independent local channels and a fully correlated two-qubit channel are inserted separately in six configurations. Propagating each Pauli-error realization through the Clifford circuit yields the effective channel on Bob's qubit and analytical expressions for the average and state-resolved fidelities.
